authorization: 2026-10-19: user approved removing YALI1D02625g from R765/R766 via an opt-in post-selection change set (identity REPORT section 9), built after committing and merging claude/clever-kare-7d2e1a; kept gene guarded on its current model identity; the pre-existing +2 charge residual is recorded, the equation is kept.

R765.evidence: YALI1D02625g (NCBI Gene 2910520, XP_502319.1, 347 aa, UniProt Q6CAJ3, CLIB122 YALI0D02277g) carries only a transketolase N-terminal (PP) domain (Pfam PF00456): no pyrimidine-binding or C-terminal domain, so no catalytic glutamate (yeast TKL1 E418); the GDG Mg2+/ThDP motif is Glu-Glu and ThDP His69 is Asp. The transketolase active site spans the PP domain of one subunit and the PYR domain of the other, so the protein cannot form a complete active site alone (inferred). No adjacent or genome-annotated partner domain exists (tblastn +-30 kb, W29 BLAST, CLIB122 Pfam); 13 strain assemblies give the identical 347-aa protein; it is expressed at low level (RNA-seq; MS about 0.6% of transketolase). It entered R765/R766 only through the 2026-06-02 EC-match isozyme table (KEGG K00615). The kept YALI1E07744g = NCBI Gene 2912397, XP_503628.3, UniProt Q6C6T4 'Transketolase', 694 aa, all three domains; the source model iyali26.xml has this rule. Identity by homology and structure prediction only; no Yarrowia lipolytica enzymology for either gene. The equation is not edited; its +2 charge residual is pre-existing (protonation convention).
